component.name: IziProxy
component.summary: Deploy Xray (VLESS + REALITY) on your own server in a few clicks

description.p: IziProxy connects to a VPS over SSH, installs Xray with VLESS + REALITY and gives you ready-to-use connection links and QR codes.
It also shows the Xray service status and traffic statistics, validates the server configuration and helps replace a blocked SNI domain.
